beginner.title: Get started with Ideogram
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Ideogram, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Ask well, check everything
beginner.outcome: You can: get useful, checkable answers from Ideogram
topics: giving role, task, context and format
beginner.practice: Ask Ideogram to explain a concept from your work, then verify two claims

beginner.title: Use it safely
beginner.outcome: You can: protect private data while using Ideogram

intermediate.title: Reusable prompts for your job
intermediate.outcome: You can: build prompt templates for repeated tasks
intermediate.practice: Create three prompts for your weekly tasks

intermediate.title: Research and summarise with sources
intermediate.outcome: You can: summarise documents and find sources responsibly
intermediate.practice: Summarise a public report with page references

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Ideogram
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Ideogram distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Ideogram
expert.outcome: You can: use Ideogram's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Build with it
expert.outcome: You can: put Ideogram inside a workflow or product
expert.practice: Automate one recurring task with a human sign-off step

expert.title: Integrate Ideogram into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Ideogram with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Ideogram to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Ideogram well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Ideogram" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
